note: Cold open (24_NARRATIVE_REVISION §7.1 beats 1-4, tasks M1-51 and M1-52): beat 1 is 6 s of an Earth mustard field in the wind (shot F, Veo 3.1 from the approved start frame, yellows graded -6° toward the battery band's gold) with SFX_EARTH_FIELD_MORNING, then a hard cut to the Moon: shot A holds wide for 2 s in total silence, then accelerates to the station and dives through the porthole into the commons (shot B) as the fans fade in; a push-in ends on the gold band of the battery hologram under the title. The EX-CH01-S01 lines play in-engine at the mission table (M1-49); CUE-01 enters after the charter. Shot C (Ferreira on the Earth screen) is unused.
